name: Sande (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sande (a church, a lion and wavy bars on yellow and blue).
history: Municipal flag of Sande; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Sande arms — church, lion and wavy bars
